main_text.p: [חום] Ch. Ungue secare, rumpere, vel discerpere, Digitis evellere, avellere, Lev.1.15. in Jon. & cap.5. 8. Gen.31.19. in eodem.

[חזק] Syr. Peregre abire, proficisci, Iter facere. Item Tenere, retinere, prehendere, coprehendere: Joh.20.7. [Syriac] Sudarium, quod comprehesum, seu alligatum erat in capite ejus. Item Cingere, Cinctum, accinctum esse, ad Ephes.6.14. & 1.Pet.1.12. (14.
[Syriac] Syr. Vinculu, copula, ad Eph.4.3. & Colost.3.

[חזר] Ch. Redire, reverti, circumire, converti, convertere se: Ithpahel [אתחזר] Idem. Aphel [אחזר] Idem. Item Redire fecit, reduxit, circumduxit, Restituit, vertit, convertit, evertit, pervertit, invertit, convolvit.
[חזורנות] Chald. Ambitus, circuitus: Item adverbialiter, Circum, circa.
[חזור] Ch. Globus, Sphaerula: Item Pomum, Malogranatum, a rotunditate: Item, Circum, circa, Ps.50.3. Plur. [חזורין] const. [חזורי].
[חזירא] Ch. & Syr. Sus, porcus, quod ejus proprium sit ad sordes Redire. Plur. [חזירין] Syr. [Syriac] Grex porcorum, Lucae 8.32. Foemin. [חזירתא], Porca.
[מחוור] Ch. Circul, cyclus. Plur. [מחוורין] Gen.1.14. in Jon.
[חטא] Ch. & Syr. Peccare, ut Hebraice. Aphel [אחטי] Peccare fecit, vel fivit, ad Peccandu induxit.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are only approximated in this transcription; Syriac and some pointed Hebrew forms are not reliably read. Marks such as the superscript letters and small references are uncertain.
